title: Acknowledgements answer
description: What an agent answers a request to acknowledge several members of one principle, or the members several principles map, holding: the request's id, its basis naming each member, and under members one entry per member, keyed by its id, holding what a one-member answer holds beside its head. Fields this tool does not read are refused, but for answer_with and each entry's role, or roles across principles, which the template printed alone carries for the agent to read and which are read as nothing. Models::Acknowledgements refuses an answer whose members differ from its basis, and each entry is checked as Models::Acknowledgement checks a one-member answer.

answer_with.description: The command that submits this answer from the file it is saved in, as the template printed alone carries it. Sent back, it is read as nothing.

principle_ids.description: The principles that each acknowledge the members they map, when the request names several.

additionalProperties.description: One member's judgement, read as a one-member answer's fields beside its request_id and basis are read (acknowledgement-answer.schema.json).

roles.description: The member's role by each principle that maps it, which the template printed alone across principles carries beside meaning_kept for the agent judging it. Sent back, it is read as nothing.

role.description: The member's role as its map names it, which the template printed alone carries beside meaning_kept for the agent judging it. Sent back, it is read as nothing.

x-unread-field-advice.not_run_reason: a check that cannot be run here needs a full audit: start one instead

check_result.description: The result of the member's check, which the answer reports when the member has one: the command as the map names it, or left out to read as the request printed it, and its exit_status, which must be 0, since a check that fails or cannot be run is a full audit's to judge, with review_basis when a new line says what its review rested on; for this tool's own list-member-problems --short, which exits 3 while it lists the member, 3 with the member ids it lists under listed_members, each one this answer acknowledges. Models::ReportedCheck checks it.
